card.title: How To Fix an iPhone SE 2020 That Does Not Turn On, Stuck at 0.043 Amps

source.title: How To Fix an iPhone SE 2020 That Does Not Turn On, Stuck at 0.043 Amps

claims.statement: iPhone SE 2020 that draws nothing before power-on and sits at about 43 mA after prompting boot: look for absent rails and for coils near the CPU/PMIC that have come loose.

procedure: Confirm the 43 mA stall on a DC supply.
Check rails and inspect/probe coils around CPU and PMIC.
card.caveats: Very short page; the specific rail is not identified. Community-written Repair Wiki page, paraphrased; check the linked page (and its images) before acting on a reading.
